spec.name: customers-orders-portal
spec.stack: Our usual web stack — Next.js (frontend) + NestJS (backend/API), TypeScript, Postgres via Prisma — with Supabase providing authentication and file storage (a platform we have not used before). Runs locally only; NOT deployed in this run.
spec.description: OBJECTIVE: Build a SMALL internal web app (this is replica/run 3, 'rep 3') that lists our customers and, for each customer, their orders. Scope is intentionally small and internal-only. PLATFORM: our usual web stack (Next.js + NestJS + TypeScript + Postgres/Prisma), EXCEPT that authentication and file storage MUST be implemented on Supabase — a new platform for us — not on our own stack. Supabase Auth handles login/sessions; Supabase Storage handles any file uploads/attachments. DATA: the app lists customers and their orders; default assumption (stated for confirmation) is to seed a small local dataset for the listing, with the option to back it by our existing HubSpot (customers) / Veeqo (orders) connectors later — no external data wiring is required for this small rep. FOLDERS: all work lives inside the project's own folder (its localPath), created if missing; nothing is written at the Odin app repo root. DEPLOY: explicitly DO NOT deploy it yet — build and verify locally only; no VM sync, no firewall change, no production touch. The Supabase account/project must be connected and tested BEFORE generation since we have never used it.
features: Authentication via Supabase Auth (login/logout, protected internal routes, session handling)
Per-customer orders view (orders listed under each customer)
File upload/attachment backed by Supabase Storage
Small seed dataset for customers & orders (local), structured to later swap to HubSpot/Veeqo
Internal-only access (no public signup; invite/seeded users)
Local run only — no deployment, no VM sync in this run

features.name: Back the listing with real data from HubSpot + Veeqo
features.why: We already have both connected; customers from HubSpot and orders from Veeqo would make the portal reflect real data instead of seed rows — but it adds integration scope, so left as a recommendation.

members.why: Supabase Auth is new to us and governs access to internal customer/order data; a quick review of auth flow, RLS policies, and storage bucket permissions would de-risk a first-time platform. Not auto-staffed.
